name: Bwindi & Kibale
about: Gorilla and chimp trekking plus outstanding birding; dry seasons (Jun–Aug, Dec–Feb) make for firmer, less strenuous trails.
overview: Gorilla trekking in Bwindi and chimpanzee tracking in Kibale, at roughly half Rwanda's permit price for a similar experience.
costOverview: Gorilla and chimp permits are the two real expenses here — at roughly half Rwanda's price for a similar gorilla trek.

specialSeasons.text: Drier trails make gorilla and chimpanzee trekking easier and less strenuous.
